content.text:
The user wants me to say hello in exactly three words. Let me think of options:
- "Hello there friend" - 3 words
- "Hi, how are" - no, incomplete
- "Hello, my friend" - 3 words
- "Greetings to you" - 3 words
- "Hello to you" - 3 words

I'll go with "Hello, my friend" - it's warm, natural, and exactly three words.
